name: LCTITAN
recent: Lotte Chemical Titan 2026财年第三季度净亏损扩大至2.455亿令吉，营收环比下降8.3%但同比增长98.5%。公司涉及一起重大诉讼，已获法院暂缓审理以待仲裁。市场传闻有股东可能出售股权。
notable: 2026年第三季度净亏损扩大至2.455亿令吉，连续第18个季度亏损。
公司获得法院暂缓令，涉及石油物流案件的诉讼待仲裁。
市场传闻有股东可能出售Lotte Chemical Titan股权。
risks: 净亏损扩大，9个月累计亏损近10亿令吉。
重大诉讼待仲裁，结果存在不确定性。
营收环比下降8.3%，利润率承压。
earnings: 2026年第三季度营收28.51亿令吉，环比下降8.3%，同比增长98.5%；净亏损2.455亿令吉，净亏损率8.6%，较上季度的5.6%扩大。

recent_en: Lotte Chemical Titan's 3Q FY2026 net loss widened to RM245.5 million, with revenue down 8.3% QoQ but up 98.5% YoY. The company is involved in material litigation and has obtained a stay of court proceedings pending arbitration. Market talk suggests a potential stake sale.
notable_en: 3Q 2026 net loss widened to RM245.5 million, marking the 18th consecutive quarterly loss.
The company obtained a court stay of proceedings in a petroleum logistics litigation pending arbitration.
Market talk surfaced about a potential stake sale in Lotte Chemical Titan.
risks_en: Net loss widened, with 9M cumulative loss nearing RM1 billion.
Material litigation pending arbitration, outcome uncertain.
Revenue declined 8.3% QoQ amid margin pressure.
earnings_en: 3Q 2026 revenue was RM2.851 billion, down 8.3% QoQ but up 98.5% YoY; net loss was RM245.5 million with a net margin of -8.6%, wider than -5.6% in the previous quarter.
